notes: The support-verb frame keeps its own 'on' inside s003, the frame's supplied 'mind' being what licenses it and the object being accusative (rule 21's frame clause, rule 106's accusative arm); head on 'mind', the word the corpus spends on φρονέω (rules 17, 91).
The repeated 'on' at t011 is a rule 7 helper on the coordinate member the article introduces, never `added` (rules 86, 103); the article writes a determiner, so it carries the repetition (rule 21).
τὰ + ἄνω and τὰ + ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς analysed alike (rule 24), the copula going to the adverb and to the preposition (rule 53).
